subject: Important Updates Regarding Your Recent Job Application
body: Dear [Applicant's Name], We would like to inform you that we have received your job application for the Marketing Specialist position at our company. Our hiring team is currently reviewing all applications and will be in touch with you soon regarding the next steps in the recruitment process. We appreciate your interest in joining our team and look forward to potentially working together. Should you have any questions in the meantime, please feel free to reach out to us. Best regards, Hiring Manager
